draft.title: Atoms and elements
card: An atom is a very small particle that makes up all matter. Atoms are the building blocks of every substance.
An element is a substance made of only one type of atom. Gold is an element because it contains only gold atoms.
An element cannot be broken down into simpler substances by chemical reactions.
Each element has a symbol of one or two letters. The first letter is always a capital and the second is lower case, such as O for oxygen and Na for sodium.
draft.remember: An element has one type of atom only, and it has its own symbol.

a.q: Why is copper classed as an element?
opts: It is made of only one type of atom
It is made of atoms joined in a fixed ratio
It is a mixture of metals with similar atoms
It is made of atoms that are all joined in pairs
a.why: An element is a substance made of only one type of atom, and copper contains only copper atoms. Atoms joined in a fixed ratio describes something else, because an element does not need different atoms joined together.
a.clue: Think about how many types of atom an element contains.

b.q: Priya reads that the symbol for sodium is Na. Which symbol is written correctly, following the rules on the card?
opts: Na, with a capital N and a lower case a
NA, with both letters as capitals
na, with both letters in lower case
nA, with a lower case n and a capital A
b.why: A symbol starts with a capital letter, and any second letter is lower case, so sodium is Na. NA is the most tempting wrong option, but it breaks the rule about the second letter.
b.clue: Check which letter is a capital and which is not.

a.best: It is made of only one type of atom

b.best: Na, with a capital N and a lower case a

problems.detail: The stem already says 'the symbol for sodium is Na', so a student can match the option to the stem without applying the capital and lower-case rule. Use a different element, or ask about the rule without showing the answer.

check.summary: The card and question a are sound. Question b gives its answer away, because the stem states that sodium's symbol is Na.
